product_one_liner.value: Koodisi is an enterprise iPaaS that connects CRM, ERP, HRMS, ITSM, and 100+ business systems through no-code workflow automation and built-in API management for enterprise integration teams.

pricing_page.notes: Koodisi, a product of Ivoyant LLC, publicly lists an Enterprise plan with quotes based on deployment and support needs.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn reports 82 employees as of 2026-09-30; a separate October 2026 estimate is about 85.

eng_blog.notes: The index lists at least two technical build posts; their authors are identified as a software engineer and a machine-learning engineer.

public_docs.notes: Koodisi has a public documentation site with multiple product and AI workflow articles and release notes.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists an AI/ML Engineer opening.

model_provider.value: OpenAI (available as a configurable, user-authenticated workflow integration; no default product-wide model is specified)
model_provider.notes: The documentation describes OpenAI REST API activities using the customer’s OpenAI account/API key, while the AI workflow docs describe provider selection and credentials as configurable.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page says SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits are approved but certificates are still in the issuing pipeline, so neither counts as an issued certification.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn reports that iVoyant has not raised any funding rounds.

raised_18mo.notes: The company is reported as unfunded and as having raised no rounds.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live SDR posting dated 2026-10-31 is listed with a validity date of 2026-11-30.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 2026 release notes announce new Agent Studio and Koodisi AI capabilities, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The official team page lists the small leadership roster; no C-level or VP-level join or departure in the 12-month window is shown or announced in the checked sources.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The current SDR posting says Apollo, LinkedIn, email, and HubSpot are used for prospecting, outreach, and tracking.
